Players Committee card image of [[Plo Koon (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to same location as Ahsoka (or vice versa). Once per turn, may lose top card of Force Pile to make your character (or piloted [Episode I] starfighter) here forfeit +2 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn.” Uploaded unchanged.
